name: bizplug-cleaning
description: The cleaning services plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: price a clean by home size and book. It works from the business's own published profile, covering packages, pricing and booking requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
